# Upstream attribution

The card metadata in `data/cards.json` was extracted from `asundr/gwent-classic`, commit `08592d847f2573440a34deb9f32bc855b2544cdd` (MIT + Commons Clause v1.0; licensor Arun Sundaram). The upstream license text is preserved in this directory.

Upstream repository: https://github.com/asundr/gwent-classic

The port does not currently bundle the upstream `img/`, `sfx/`, or `svg/` directories. The extracted `filename` strings are identifiers only. Asset files require a separate inventory and redistribution review before being included in a public release.
